{{Short description|Operation which introduces existential quantification}}
In [[formal semantics (natural language)|formal semantics]], '''existential closure''' is an operation which introduces [[existential quantification]]. It was first posited by [[Irene Heim]] in her 1982 dissertation, as part of her analysis of [[Article_(grammar)#Indefinite_article|indefinite]]s. In her formulation, existential closure is a form of ''unselective binding'' which [[binding (linguistics)|binds]] any number of variables of any semantic type.<ref>{{cite encyclopedia |last1= Brasoveanu |first1=Adrian |last2=Farkas |first2=Donka |editor-last1=Aloni |editor-first1=Maria |editor1-link=Maria Aloni| editor-last2=Dekker |editor-first2=Paul |encyclopedia= The Cambridge Handbook of Formal Semantics |title=Indefinites|access-date= |language= |edition=|year=2016 |pages=238–266 |publisher=Cambridge University Press |location= |isbn= 9781107028395|doi=10.1017/CBO9781139236157.009}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis |last=Heim |first=Irene |date=1982 |title= The Semantics of Definite and Indefinite Noun Phrases |chapter=Chapter 2: Indefinites as Variables |publisher=University of Massachusetts, Amherst |url=https://semanticsarchive.net/Archive/jA2YTJmN/Heim%20Dissertation%20with%20Hyperlinks.pdf}}</ref> In [[alternative semantics]] and related frameworks, the term is often applied to a closely related operation which existentially quantifies over a set of [[proposition|propositional]] alternatives.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Kratzer |first1=Angelika |last2=Shimoyama |first2=Junko |year=2002 |title=Indeterminate pronouns: The view from Japanese |url=https://people.umass.edu/partee/RGGU_2004/Indeterminate%20Pronouns.pdf |journal= Proceedings of the Third Tokyo Conference on Psycholinguistics}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Ciardelli |first1=Ivano |last2=Roelofsen |first2=Floris |last3=Theiler |first3=Nadine |date=2017 |title= Composing alternatives |url=https://pure.uva.nl/ws/files/9798134/Composing_alternatives.pdf |journal=Linguistics and Philosophy |volume=40 |issue=1|pages=1–36 |doi=10.1007/s10988-016-9195-2|doi-access=free }}</ref>
